claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows two lenses present (one attached, one detached) but no focal length markings are legible, so the specific lens specs cannot be confirmed.

claims.claim: Clean and good to shoot videos and snapshots
claims.evidence: No shot shows sensor, lens glass, or a powered-on/functional test; condition and working status cannot be assessed from a static photo.

risks.risk: Exact camera model unknown, which affects base value significantly
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the model name/number on the body (front or top plate) or a shot of the serial number area
risks.if_unproven: priced as base/unspecified low-end Nikon DSLR body

risks.risk: Sensor and lens glass condition (scratches, fungus, dust, haze) not visible
risks.proof: Macro photo of lens front/rear elements and a photo through the lens against a bright light, plus a close-up of the sensor with lens off
risks.if_unproven: priced as having possible optical defects

risks.proof: Screenshot from a shutter-count checker app or a test photo showing the count on camera menu

risks.risk: Unverified that camera powers on and functions (autofocus, shutter, video mode)
risks.proof: Short video clip of the camera powering on, taking a photo, and recording a few seconds of video

risks.risk: Accessories (battery, charger, memory card, bag, caps) not shown, may not be included
risks.proof: Photo of all included accessories laid out together
risks.if_unproven: priced as body+lenses only, no accessories

risks.risk: Second lens's exact specs (18-55 vs 50mm) unconfirmed, could be mismatched or lower-value variant
risks.proof: Close-up photo of each lens barrel showing focal length/aperture markings
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic kit lens, not premium prime

proof_requests: Close-up of camera body model name/number and serial number
Macro/close-up shots of both lenses' front and rear glass
Photo of lens barrels showing focal length and aperture text
Short video of camera powering on, focusing, shooting a photo, and recording video
Screenshot or display of shutter count if accessible via menu
Photo of all included accessories (battery, charger, card, bag, caps, strap)
response.reason: Witness confirms a Nikon DSLR body with an attached lens and a second detached lens, so the item type is settled, but model, lens specs, condition, and functionality are all unverified, so it must be priced at worst case pending the listed proofs.
